core.headline: Extended four-bedroom detached house in Sevenoaks
core.listing:
This four-bedroom detached house stands on a 0.3-acre plot on Beech Avenue in Sevenoaks. Built in 1968, the property has been extended to create a spacious kitchen and family room.

The ground floor comprises two reception rooms and an extended kitchen and family room. The kitchen opens into the family area, providing flexible living space. Gas central heating serves the property, with mains electricity, water and sewerage connected.

Four bedrooms are arranged on the first floor, served by two bathrooms. The principal bedroom occupies the front of the house.

The rear garden extends to approximately 0.3 acres and is accessed from the kitchen and family room. A driveway provides off-street parking and leads to a double garage.

Sevenoaks town centre lies within reach, with shops, restaurants and the railway station offering services to London. The property is situated in a residential area with good outdoor mobile signal coverage on major networks. FTTC broadband is available.

Guide Price £850,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band G (Sevenoaks District Council). EPC rating D. Construction: Standard. Electricity: Mains. Water: Mains (metered). Sewerage: Mains. Heating: Gas central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: Good outdoor coverage on major networks. Parking: Driveway. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: None known. Japanese knotweed found in the rear garden near the boundary in 2025; herbicide treatment plan by a PCA-registered contractor in progress, with a 10-year insurance-backed guarantee.
core.summary: Extended four-bedroom detached house on a 0.3-acre plot with double garage and driveway parking. Built in 1968, the property features an extended kitchen and family room, two receptions, and a substantial rear garden.
keyFeatures: Gas central heating with mains services
Japanese knotweed treatment plan in progress with 10-year guarantee
